output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.

The setPrices function uses the `msg.sender` as the pivot user, which means that the order of the arguments is critical. This allows the attacker to manipulate the `sellPrice` and `buyPrice` for any user.
The freezeAccount function is called by the owner, allowing the owner to set the freeze status of any user.
The buy function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of the contract to any value.
The sell function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of the contract to any value.
